store.write_rule: Exclusive writer; append length+canonical typed record+digest; fsync record and directory before receipt; conflicting duplicate key denies
store.transport: Dedicated credential-free full-tuple message; writer independently validates predecessor/reservation and required witness signatures
store.filesystem_authority_and_crash_atomicity: NOT_PROVEN; path is a proposed design binding, never a live durable identity

authentication: External witness verifies chain and independent outcome proof; mutation worker cannot write/sign audit or outcome
